content: Konuwonūwana Yaubada ina matakoi gagaina toina iivinida manuna! Ame nakae: Kita ivayokoida natunao! Go moe moitamo, kita natunao! Moe pasina da poyapoya
geya siyagoideta, unana Yaubada geya siyagoiyeta.

Guna kaloyao, ame tutayana kita Yaubada natunao go, Yaubada geya ivatulukoideta kita nava bei nakonakae. Go tayagoi bego Yeisu ina kaluvilamna goi kita bei Tauyana nakae unana Tauyana bei taulitoinina tagite.
Go avatauwa neta moe silootutae, toinidi sikimaasabedi Yaubada umana nakae Yeisuyana kimaasabaina.
Go avatauwa neta idi sinapu goi goyo siguuinuwe, tauyadi Yaubada ina lovina ana tokapipilovayao unana sinapu goyo tauna lovina ana kapipilova; aiyuwokova sivavasa.
Tayagoi Guyau isowóduwo bego goyo ikabi, inave go, Tauyana geya ina goyomo geya.

Tauna avatauwa neta Guyau yaina goi sikaaiyaka, e geya tuwaina goyo siguuinuwe unana Guyauyana geya ana goyomo. Go avatauwa neta nava goyo siguuinuwe, geya sinumiseta Guyau yaina go, aiyuwoina Tauyana geya siyagoiyeta, geya toina.
Natugowo, tomota idi vatulukwana polapola goi taabu sikatuubaūmi, tauna goyo koguuinuwe. Avatauwa neta guinuwa dedevidi sikiboobosidi, tauyadi tokibóbwata, nakae Guyau Tokibóbwata.

Go avatauwa neta sinapu goyo siguuinuwe, tauyadi Totagíwaya ina bodao unana poyapoya ana madágina goi go, ima ame tuta Totagiwayayana toogoyoina. Yaubada Natuna ima poyapoya ame goi unana ame: Bego Totagíwaya ina guinuwa ikausaolidi, e sikavava.

Neta Yaubada goi tabíbina, geya tuwaina sinapu goyo taguuinuwe unana Yaubada yawoina ateda goi bogina ikaaiyaka. Tauna kita geya itoboinedeta bei sinapu goyo nava taguuinuwe, unana kita Yaubada goi bogina tabíbina.

Ame nakae itoboineda taayagoi bego avatauwa Yaubada natunao go, avatauwa Totagíwaya natunao: Avatauwa neta guinuwa dedevidi geya sikibobosidita be nakae avatauwa neta siyadi geya simatakoiyeyeta, e tauyadi geya Yaubada ina bodao geya.
Moe moitamo. Boi imi numisa ana kaba vatowo goi livala ame bogina konove: Sedao tamatakooiyēdi.
Go geya kada Keni nakae geya. Tauyana Kaleya ina boda tayamo, e siyana ivakaleye ikaumate. Go kaga unana siyana ikaumate? Unana Keni ina guinuwa igoyo go, siyana ikibóbwata.
Segowo, komi tokibóbwata Ebeli nakae, tauna taabu nuwomi siwowōwana tutayana da poyapoya sikaolilivemi.
Tayagoi bego kita ámasa ana dadava bogina takalave go, yawoida vata bogina tababane. Moe taayagoi unana sedao tamatakoiyedi. Go avatauwa neta geya simatakoita, nava ámasa ana dadava goi sikaaiyaka.
Avatauwa neta siyadi sikaaolilive, tauyadi tokaumata. Go bogina kooyagoi bego geya tayaamo tokaumata yaina goi yawana vata ikaaiyaka.
E tayagoi matakoi kaga ame nakae: Guyau yawoina ikasale ámasa goi ada dedevina manuna. Tauna kita nakae itoboineda yawoida takasaledi ámasa goi sedao adi dedevina manudi.
E avatau neta maa konana go, siyana igite tayamo kónana ikiseyeseye go, neta tauyana maa konana ikubuyeve, manakae? Yaubada ina matakoi atena goi ikaaiyaka gea geya? Geya!
Natugowo, geya bóbwara kaka sopada goi tamaatakoi, go sem ame nakae: Ida guinuwa goi be nakae Yaubada ana Nanamsa Mooitamoina yaida goi tamaatakōi.
Ida matakoiyana goi bei tayagoi bego kita Yaubada ana Nanamsa Mooitamoina goi takaaiyaka be nakae Tauyana matana goi nuwoda bei tatamyabidi ame nakae:
Neta nuwoda isabutukoidi, Yaubada ina kanuwóiya ivakaigaga, nakae nuwoda itogagasave be nakae kaga liliuna kita manuda iyagoidokoidi, tauna nuwoda iyagoidi go, tuwo ikanuwoiyeda.
Guna kaloyao, neta nuwoda geya isabutukoidita, kita mada katepatu Yaubada matana goi tatáoya,
e kaga kaga takawaanoiye Tauyana yaina, bei ivinida. Moe unana Tauyana ina lovina takabikaaonedi be nakae ava guinuwava Yaubada iuyaaonedi taguuinuwedi. Tauna bei ida kawanoiyadi bei inovedi.
Ame ina lovina tayamo: Natuna Yeisu Guyau taanumīse be sedao tamatakooiyēdi nakae boi bogina ilatuuwokoida.
Neta Yaubada ina lovina takabikaaonedi, Tauyana yaida goi ikaaiyaka. Go tayagoi bego Yaubadayana yaida goi ikaaiyaka ame nakae: Balomaina bogina iivinida ivatulukoida.

footnotes.text: Da poyapoya: Ame tauyadi Yaubada ana kaleyayao unana kidi idi sinapu igoyo be nakae Yaubada sikatae.
